title: The all-temperature pressure of orthogonally invariant Ising disorder
exact_target: For $J_N=U_N$ $Lambda_N$ $U_N^T$ with $U_N$ Haar orthogonal, deterministic diagonal $Lambda_N$ whose empirical spectral laws approach compactly supported mu and whose extreme eigenvalues approach the edges of supp(mu), does the uniform-spin Ising pressure converge in mean and almost surely to $inf_p$ ${S(p)+G_1(p)}$, over the stated hierarchical trial measures? No independence of $U_N$ between different dimensions is required.
